title: TUI: quick search filter (/)
description: Goal: / opens a search line that filters the visible pebbles across all projects. Bare alphanumeric terms are exact-match filters against short id, title, and description; space-separated terms are independent (all must match), so 'pane edit' finds a pebble whose title is 'Edit pane'. s: filters by status (s:t = todo, s:!d = anything but done); t: filters by issue type (t:bug). Enter accepts, Esc clears. Design: flat leaf list per project (like the r filter); projects with no matches are hidden. Land with a SPEC r[tui-search] rule, unit tests on the pure query parser/matcher, and termlens e2e coverage.
